description: A Japanese man in his thirties, native Japanese speaker. A rich, warm, resonant baritone voice with a dramatic, cinematic movie-trailer delivery, like the narrator of an anime preview. Confident and charismatic, with crisp, clear articulation.

lines.n1: ["eleven_v4","うんかいに浮かぶ、そらの港。なぎのさんばし。","calm, cinematic narrator"]
lines.n2: ["eleven_v4","最終便が帰る、その夕暮れ……","calm, cinematic narrator"]
lines.n3: ["eleven_v4","港を照らす灯晶が……消えた。","tense, dramatic"]
lines.n4: ["eleven_v4","つどうは、ひと癖ある竜たち。","intriguing, playful"]
lines.n5: ["eleven_v4","しらべろ！　まとめろ！　問いただせ！","powerful, building intensity"]
lines.n6: ["eleven_v4","嘘を見抜き、真実をつきつけろ！","powerful, heroic, shouting"]
lines.n7: ["eleven_v4","あかりは、帰ってくる人のために。","warm, gentle, emotional"]
lines.n8: ["eleven_v4","かつげききたん。ぎゃくてんろくりゅう！","epic, triumphant, title call"]
